title: Defending MIA with SynthData
summary: A research codebase (mia_sim.py) that simulates membership inference attacks against machine-learning models trained on the UCI Adult dataset and evaluates synthetic data as a defense. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, driven by an SDV Metadata object, to generate the synthetic training data whose privacy-utility tradeoff is measured against MIA attacks.
